name: Storgard
description: A city of clans during the Ice Age, which fell.

description_citations.text: "Mina". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise is born in Fyndhorn and comes to Storgard as a lone child.
timeline.quote: Freyalise came to Storgard as a lone child, seeking refuge from the frigid wastes.

citation.work: Freyalise
citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise becomes the king's court mage and falls in love with Jason Carthalion.
timeline.quote: She quickly surpassed her childhood friend Jason Carthalion and tutored him in ice magic, and the two fell in love.

citation.work: Freyalise
citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jason's green magic deals Freyalise a fatal blow in a duel ordered by Miko; she converts to green and becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: she chose to spurn red and convert to green herself.

citation.work: Freyalise
citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah helps Freyalise through her ascension.
timeline.quote: Her ascension drove her nearly mad, but she was helped by Jodah

citation.work: Freyalise
citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oriel Kjeldos flees a Johtull Wurm; Zilgeth dies casting Incineration to kill it.
timeline.quote: Zilgeth casts an Incineration spell which kills the wurm but also costs him his life.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oriel urges the Stone Council to leave Storgard, but they accuse her of blasphemy.
timeline.quote: As head of Clan Emerald , she urges the council to leave Storgard and bring their people to the south.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat warns Miko that Clan Emerald plots against him.
timeline.quote: Szat warns Miko that Clan Emerald plots against him

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An explosion in Clan Emerald's quarters kills sixteen; Miko decrees a duel to the death between Jason and Freyalise.
timeline.quote: But Miko decrees that a magical duel must decide the conflict.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jason and Freyalise duel; Szat's wind drops them on the Bridge of Hielos and the glacier crashes down on Storgard.
timeline.quote: Neither mage pauses to notice that the folly of their conflict has forced the glacier to come crashing down on the castle.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jason, influenced by Szat, uses black mana and mortally wounds Freyalise, then rejects the demon's temptation.
timeline.quote: Jason shoots the Fyndhorn Bow and wounds her mortally.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise forgives Jason and hopes to ascend.
timeline.quote: She hopes to ascend and will turn to green mana in honor of her childhood friend.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Forty days later Miko lets the Emerald and Pearl clans leave and Jason's group heads south.
timeline.quote: Jason, Oriel, Mariska, Hurn, and four dozen other people start their walk to the south.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat's Priest of Yawgmoth plots to unleash a killing cold on Dominaria from the ruins of Storgard.
timeline.quote: he wants to unleash a coldness with blue mana that will kill all living things on Dominaria

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat attacks Jaeuhl in the ruins of Soldev and an Icequake begins.
timeline.quote: an Icequake starts, and to Szat's glee, the temperature begins to drop significantly

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaeuhl finds the Amulet of Quoz and the Nova Pentacle reflects the Priest's shield.
timeline.quote: The Nova Pentacle that Jaeuhl still wears reflects the shield and sends the Priest away instead.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaeuhl tosses the Amulet of Quoz and defeats Szat.
timeline.quote: the Amulet falls head's up and grants Jaeuhl victory. Szat is defeated.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat and Lim-Dul escape through a portal to Shandalar.
timeline.quote: a portal opens up to transport Szat and Lim-Dûl to Shandalar

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor is founded by Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald, who leave Storgard before the ice covers it.
timeline.quote: Kjeldor was founded around 2434 AR by Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald

citation.work: Kjeldor
citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mariska gives the Fyndhorn Bow and Shield of the Ages to Jason Carthalion, and she and Hurn leave Storgard before its fall.
timeline.quote: Mariska and her husband left the city with Kjeldos before the Fall of Storgard

citation.work: Mina
citation.text: "Mina", section "Mariska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zilgeth sacrifices himself with an Incinerate spell to fend off a Johtull Wurm attacking Storgard.
timeline.quote: Zilgeth sacrificed himself to fend off the creature with an Incinerate spell

citation.work: Mina
citation.text: "Mina", section "Zilgeth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Zilgeth's death Freyalise becomes leader of Clan Ruby.
timeline.quote: Freyalise became the new leader of Clan Ruby
